title: TypeSomething section heading (v2)
description: A centred section heading in a light weight at 44px (30px on phones) with a loose 1.5 line height and slight negative tracking, over a one- or two-line subtitle in softened ink.
notes: the title is a ReactNode, so a wordmark or a bold word can sit inside it
name: typesomething-v2-heading

props.name: title
props.description: the heading; may hold inline elements such as a wordmark

props.name: as
props.description: heading level for the document outline

props.name: subtitleTone
props.description: subtitle at full ink (the "why" and "features" sections) or softened (the steps)
